messages.content: 你能幫我計劃一趟旅行嗎？我想先在加州舊金山找一家營業至少到晚上10點的純素餐廳。然後，我想預訂同一城市的一家酒店。我偏好從7月1日開始住3晚的豪華客房，並希望酒店可以接受寵物並有健身房。之後，我想找到金州勇士隊在接下來5場NBA比賽的賽程表。最後，我有一副撲克牌，想在裡面找到紅心的皇后。

function.name: hotel_booking
function.description: Books a hotel room given the location, room type, stay duration and any additional preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

room_type.description: Type of the room required. Options: 'single', 'double', 'deluxe', etc.

duration.description: The number of nights you want to book the hotel for.

start_date.description: The date when your stay begins.

preferences.description: Optional preferences of stay at the hotel. Default is none if not provided.

function.name: sports_team_get_schedule
function.description: Fetches the schedule of the specified sports team for the specified number of games in the given league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

num_of_games.description: Number of games for which to fetch the schedule.

league.description: The name of the sports league. If not provided, the function will fetch the schedule for all games, regardless of the league.

location.description: Optional. The city or venue where games are to be held. If not provided, all venues will be considered by default.

function.name: find_card_in_deck
function.description: Locate a particular card in a deck based on rank and suit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

rank.description: Rank of the card (e.g. Ace, Two, King).

suit.description: Suit of the card (e.g. Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).

deck.description: Deck of cards. If not provided, the deck will be a default standard 52 card deck

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format. Default is 24

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) Find vegan restaurants near San Francisco with opening until at least 22:00.

2) Book a luxury hotel in SF from July 1 for 3 nights; pet-friendly + gym.

3) Get Warriors next 5 NBA games schedule.

4) Find Queen of hearts in their deck.

We have four tool calls needed: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby, hotel_booking, sports_team_get_schedule, find_card_in_deck.

But we need to provide arguments correctly.

For vegan_restaurant_find_nearby: location: "San Francisco, CA", operating_hours=22? Actually they said open at least till 10pm -> 22h. So pass operating_hours: 22.

hotel_booking: location="San Francisco", room_type maybe "luxury"? But options include single/double/delegate but can use deluxe as luxury. They prefer pet friendly & gym. Preferences array includes "pet_friendly","gym". Duration=3 start_date="2023-07-01" (but year unspecified). Use current year? We'll assume 2023. Provide preferences list accordingly.

sports_team_get_schedule: team_name="Golden State Warriors", num_of_games=5, league="NBA".

find_card_in_deck: rank="Queen", suit="Hearts". No deck param so defaults.

We'll produce JSON calls sequentially. Then respond summarizing results. Let's do it.
